high_level_description: This image depicts a statue of a man standing on a pedestal in an outdoor setting. The statue is made of metal and appears to be painted in a dark color, possibly black or dark gray. The figure is dressed in traditional attire, including a turban, and is pointing forward with one arm extended. The other arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand resting near the chest. The pedestal is rectangular and has inscriptions written in Tamil script. The text includes dates and what seems to be a dedication or commemorative message.
